indexMetaDescription: Index of the companies with research in GerarAI: coverage of their research, rating of the latest thesis and date of the latest version.
unreadable: Its research could not be read
layersTitle: Measures which layers exist (documents, facts, thesis, model), not whether the company can be valued or the reliability of the data.
notValuableTitle: There are data layers, but inputs or sourced evidence to publish a valuation are missing.
coverageNote: Layers available indicates the presence of documents, facts, thesis and model. It does not measure data reliability nor guarantee the company can be valued.
showingMatches: Showing {from}-{to} of {total} matches for "{query}" (of {companies} companies in the registry)
zeroMatches: 0 matches for "{query}" (of {companies} companies in the registry)
noMatchDescription: No company in the registry matches that filter. Try another ticker or name, or clear the filter to see the full index.
emptyTitle: There are no companies with research yet.
emptyDescription: Search for a company and generate its research from its profile. You can also start from your watchlist.
